reviews.review_description: I love this game, the only down side is that its not very active and doesn't really have the best ways to stay entertained, but this game is actually good and not just boring. I'd definitely recommend this game if you are looking for something to play with friends, but overall 4/5 stars.

developer_response.body: Thank you for your 4 star review! We're actively attempting to push out updates to get more people to play. Enjoy Baboon!

developer_response.body: Thank you for the 5 stars and the kind words! It's awesome to hear you're enjoying the soundtrack as much as the gameplay. We appreciate the support!

reviews.review_description: This is a pretty good game. The only downside is that it doesn't have much to do and it has little players.

developer_response.body: Thank you for the positive review! We hear you on the content and player count. More features and content updates are on the way, which will help expand the game and bring in more players. Thanks for playing!
Thank you for the 5 star review! We're glad to hear that you enjoy Baboon!
